cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is CCA1301, from Beijing to Guangzhou. You are now at stand 133, with information F. Ask for your ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航1301，从北京飞往广州。你现在在133停机位，收到通播F，请求你的管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA1301, stand 133, information F, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，国航1301,133停机位，通播F，请求管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, follow VYK 02D Departure, initial climb 1200m on QNH1023, cruising level 10,300m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，按照VYK 02D离场，初始爬升至1200米，修正海压1023，巡航高度10300米，离场后联系120.6，应答机4523。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, follow VYK 02D Departure, initial climb 1200m on QNH1023, cruising level 10,300m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，按照VYK 02D离场，初始爬升至1200米，修正海压1023，巡航高度10300米，离场后联系120.6，应答机4523，国航1301。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are ready for pushback and startup, contact Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你准备好推出开车了，联系地面。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，国航1301，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，可以推出开车，面朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，面朝西，国航1301。

cards.audioText: N: [All engines have been started, everything checked out normal, request taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【所有发动机已经启动，所有项目检查正常，请求滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, request taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，国航1301，请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, taxi to runway 35R via taxiway Y3, T5 and E to holding point C2.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，经由Y3，T5和E，滑行至跑道35右等待点C2。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to runway 35R via taxiway Y3 and T5 and E to holding point C2, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Y3，T5和E，滑行至跑道35右等待点C2，国航1301。

cards.audioText: N: [You are now at holding point of runway 35R. You want to take off immediately.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在跑道35右外等待点，你想立即起飞。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, holding point of runway 35R, request immediate departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1301，跑道35右外等待点，请求立即起飞。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1301, Beijing Tower, negative at the moment, traffic on final, hold short of runway 35R, report the traffic on final in sight.
N: [Inform the controller you’ve got the visual contact to the aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1301，北京塔台，暂时不行，五边上有航空器，在跑道35右外等待，看到五边上的航空器后报。
【告知管制员你已经看到航空器了。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, holding short of runway 35R, traffic in sight, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，在跑道35右外等待，看到航空器了，国航1301。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, Beijing Tower, after the landing traffic vacated from G6, line up and wait.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，北京塔台，在着陆航空器通过G6脱离后，上跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: After the landing traffic vacated from G6, line up and wait, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在着陆航空器通过G6脱离后，上跑道等待，国航1301。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, wind 300 at 6, runway 35R, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，风向300，6米每秒，跑道35右，可以起飞。

cards.audioText: N: [During the takeoff rolling, you read high starboard engine vibration. For safety precautions, you performed a rejected takeoff and shut down the starboard engine. Inform controller your situation, and you also want to know if there is any visual fire on the landing gears and tyres.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在起飞滑跑期间，你的右发抖震偏高，出于安全起见，你执行了中断起飞并关闭了右发。告知管制员此情况，并且你想知道起落架和轮胎处是否有明火。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, we aborted takeoff due right engine vibration, and we’ve shut down the engine. Confirm if there is any visual fire on the landing gears and tyres.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1301，由于右发抖震，我们执行了中断起飞，我们已经关断了右发。证实我们的起落架和轮胎处是否有明火。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1301, Beijing Tower, negative, no visual fire on the landing gears or tyres, report intention.
N: [Tell the controller you want to vacate runway and taxi to the ramp for a thorough check but you have to wait to cool the brakes for about 5 minutes. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1301，北京塔台，不，起落架和轮胎处没有明火。报告意图。
【告知管制员你想脱离跑道，滑行至机坪进行全面检查，但是你需要等待大约5分钟来冷却刹车。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request vacate runway and taxi to the ramp for a check after cooling the brakes for about 5 minutes., CCA1301
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求冷却刹车大概5分钟后脱离跑道，滑行至机坪进行全面检查， 国航1301。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA1301, when ready, take next right on G4, contact Ground on 122.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，国航1301，准备好后。使用下一个右方脱离道G4，联系地面122.7。
cards.referenceTextZh: 下一个右方脱离道G4，122.7，国航1301。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, Beijing Ground, taxi back to the apron via G4, G and Y6.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，北京地面，经由滑行道G4，G和Y6滑行至机坪。
cards.referenceText: Taxi back to the apron via G4, G and Y6, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道G4，G和Y6滑行至机坪，国航1301。

cards.audioText: N: [During taxi back, you noticed an A320 ahead of you is leaking a significant amount of fuel from the bottom of the left engine. Tell ATC about the situation. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在滑行过程中，你发现前面的A320从左发底部漏出大量燃油。告知管制员此情况。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, an A320 ahead of us is leaking fuel from left engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，国航1301，我们前面的A320左发正在漏油。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, roger, hold for a few minutes, the airport maintenance staff and services will be there in a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，收到，等待几分钟，机场机务人员和服务将会在几分钟后到达。

cards.audioText: N: [It is late in the night, the maintenance engineers have fixed all the problems and you’re now on the runway 35R. Request takeoff clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在已经是夜里，机务人员已经解决了所有问题，你现在在跑道35右。请求起飞许可。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, runway 35R, request departure clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1301，跑道35右，请求离场许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, change to CY08 departure, wind calm, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，更改为CY08离场，静风，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: CY08 departure, cleared for takeoff, CCA1301.

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, keep runway heading until 800m, after airborne, contact Beijing Departure on 119.5 for further instructions, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，保持跑道航向直到800米。离地后联系北京离场119.5，再见。
cards.referenceText: Runway heading until 800m, 119.5, good day, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道航向直到800米，119.5，再见，国航1301。
